entries.title: V3 duplicate build stream not executed; no new V3 catalogue authoring until the owner has tested the deployed wave
entries.rationale: Follows owner-build-deploy-then-test-2026-10-05 (logged 09:37:48Z, after VALUES-100 at 06:02Z, so it is the later directive). The V3 catalogue run stopped at 09:36:53Z (0 writes to its paths in the 36 min to 10:13Z), mid-topic. It was not still running, as the build report inferred.
entries.reversal: The owner finishes hands-on testing and approves a re-scoped V3 plan built from a per-topic coverage table.

entries.title: Trusting the prompt ('use the id exactly') plus the DeepSeek cross-check to keep catalogue specs tied to real kit ids
entries.what_broke: 3 unknown kit ids in 2 of 20 topic files. c4-maths-ch06-t01 game targets m-is-10cm, but the kit id is m-m-is-10cm. c6-hindi-ch05-t01 game and explainer target m-doha-four-lines, but the kit uses mc-doha-four-lines. The model cross-check gave c6-hindi-ch05-t01 verdict=pass. ext.test.mjs catalogue test failed (106/107).
entries.fix: evals/studio-catalogue/author.mjs authorSpec now rejects a spec that cites an id outside the topic's kit (predicate check, retried with the valid ids as feedback). The 3 ids were corrected in the topic files. ext.test.mjs is now 107/107.
